title: Crispy Pistachio Ricotta Cannoli Dip
hookLine: All the flavor of Sicilian cannoli in a 5-minute no-bake whipped ricotta dip with waffle chips.

items.name: Mascarpone or cream cheese + 1/2 cup powdered sugar

steps.title: Preheat Waffle Iron & Prep Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your waffle iron or griddle to medium-high heat and brush lightly with butter or neutral oil. Measure out {ricotta_cn} and {mascar_cn} in a mixing bowl so the batter or dough is ready as soon as the iron is hot.

steps.title: Whip Ricotta Smooth & Fold Chips
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {ricotta_cn} and {mascar_cn} with a pinch of cinnamon until fluffy. Fold in {chips_cn} and serve immediately with broken waffle cones!
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {chips_cn} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cool 1 Minute on Rack & Plate
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Crispy Pistachio Ricotta Cannoli Dip onto a wire rack for 60 seconds so steam escapes and the outside stays crisp. Top with {chips_cn} and serve immediately into 6 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 8 mins.
